data.gender_notes: Frans is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Germanic elements fr meaning ‘man’ or ‘free’ and hans meaning ‘man’ or ‘hand’. The name Frans was popular during the Middle Ages and was brought to England by the Normans. It has been used interchangeably with the name Francis, which means ‘French man’ or ‘man from France’. Frans is a name of strong character and independence, suitable for a child with a free spirit.
data.etymology: Frans belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Free man.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Frans total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_greek.name: Φρανς
